entry.title: Frodhes 0.9.13
entry.summary: **Frodhes 0.9.13**: a physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba for the M-VAVE FM-1, the Ableton Move, the Akai MPC and your computer. Every note is computed live from the mechanics of the instrument; there are no samples. **Download:** `frodhes.fwsc` below (the same file as `frodhes-0.9.13.fwsc`; the newest is always at https://github.com/leonardoMirabal/frodhes/releases/latest/download/frodhes.fwsc). **Try it first in your browser:** https://leonardomirabal.github.io/frodhes/

entry.title: Frodhes 0.9.12
entry.summary: **Frodhes 0.9.12** runs the FM-1 on both cores with 14 voices in one package and adds Frodhes for the Akai MPC. It also brings the reverb back to its full level on HALL and INFINITE, gives SUITCASE its own clean, round voice again, and adds a cleaner upper register on every electric piano, a clearer MARIMBA mallet tick at high NOISE, richer soft notes on the Move, the plugin and the Akai MPC, a new MIX law on DELAY, DRIVE and REVERB, a fuller velocity response on the electric piano, update notic
